node.title: Divi Theme
node.content:
[wpsm_toplist] Invite to our Divi review! In this short article, we'll take a deep explore the inner workings of Elegant's Divi style, examine the functions it offers, discuss just how to use it, consider the prices, and end up by offering you our judgment on whether it's worth the investment.  

Divi Theme by Elegant themes

As mentioned, Divi is the flagship creation of Elegant Themes. It’s what’s commonly referred to as a mega theme. In other words, it’s much like a standard WordPress theme, but better, and bigger… a lot bigger.   Divi’s can serve multiple purposes and fit any kind of website. Basically, no matter what type of site you want to build (and no matter the design as well), Divi promises it can handle the job.

Design & How to use it?

As pointed out, Divi is the flagship development of Stylish Themes. It's what's generally referred to as a mega style. In other words, it's similar to a basic WordPress motif, however much better, as well as larger ... a lot larger. Divi's can serve multiple objectives and fit any type of sort of internet site. Primarily, whatever kind of website you want to develop (as well as no matter the design also), Divi guarantees it can take care of the job. Since Divi is an exceptional style (extra on the rates soon), you can't find it via WordPress.org's default motif directory site. Rather, you have to go to Stylish Motifs, sign up with the club, and get your own ZIP documents consisting of the motif. As soon as you have the ZIP documents, it installs like any type of various other themes-- with the panel found in Appearance → Themes → Add New → Upload Themes. You can continue to the style's primary setups when you're done with the installation and also have the Themes energetic. Divi has its very own food selection generally sidebar where you can locate the web link to that setups panel: There's undoubtedly a lot of things you can adjust there, but if you can't be bothered to experience all that you don't in fact need to. Or, a minimum of, changing all these setups one at a time doesn't have to be the very first point you finish with Divi. The very best means to really learn more about Divi is to develop a new homepage for your web site. That's exactly what I'm going to perform in this Divi testimonial. It all jobs just as you would certainly expect. You need to create an empty page and also appoint it as the front page in Settings → Reading. Next, you can proceed to modify the web page with the Divi Builder. The method the web page building contractor portion of Divi works is very similar to the various other home builder options on the market, such as Beaver Home Builder or Elementor. Below's a quick rundown of Divi's page company structure: Your page’s content comprises sections… which can contain one or more rows… which in turn can contain one or more columns… which finally contain individual content blocks. Sounds complicated, perhaps, but it’s actually pretty easy to comprehend once you start working with Divi. Here’s an example page structure (you can see all of the essential elements — sections, rows, and content blocks inside columns): Balancing every one of those rows, columns, and content blocks is just how you create a page with Divi. To get started, proceed to modify your homepage, and also click on the huge button that claims Use The Divi Builder.

The feature set of Divi

As I pointed out earlier, the most significant selling point of Divi is it's an all-in-one solution for developing the exact internet site layout you require-- and it likewise uses a wonderful bundle of performance to go alongside. I already listed a few of this above, but I want to provide you a much more comprehensive listing right here, so you can realize the number of attributes Divi actually packs:. It permits you to design/build your website in genuine time. There's a live preview of everything you're doing. There's no demand to complete a kind on some setups web page, click 'Save' and after that rejuvenate the page to see if the effect is alright. Divi does away with all that. Whatever you see on the web page is customizable. Text modifying is carried out in a click-to-type way-- basically, it functions just like an MS Word paper. The designs are all mobile responsive. You reach use multiple rows, columns as well as content aspects. Divi features more than 20 pre-made formats out of the box. You can conserve your layouts and export/import them to use on various other websites. You can conserve your own global aspects, which comes in handy if you have something you wish to use multiple times throughout the website. Almost everything resolves drag and also decreases. Last, yet not least, the library of content aspects offered is really outstanding:. These alone are sufficient to develop basically any type of sort of site, however, surprisingly, when you begin smelling around searching for what else is there, you'll find points such as Divi's Module Customizer (where you can modify exactly how each of the common web content modules looks), or Divi's terrific split-testing module. If you're on the fencing about which specific block of message you must utilize on your homepage, you can use them both as well as see which does better. Divi additionally comes translated into 32 languages-- with right-to-left languages included, also.

Pricing details

The Divi style is a cost item, but the rate design is an initial one in the WordPress space. Generally, rather than paying for the theme itself, you get access to Elegant Themes' whole directory of plugins and motifs. The good news is, this does not turn out to be that pricey. Presently, the subscription comes in two flavors:. [wpsm_price_table] [wpsm_price_column size="2" featured="no" name="Yearly Access" price="$89" per="Year" button_color="orange" button_url="https://www.elegantthemes.com/join/" button_text="Buy Now"]
  • Access To Divi, Extra, Bloom & Monarch
  • Hundreds Of Website Packs
  • Product Updates
  • Premium Support
  • Unlimited Website Usage
  • Risk-Free Guarantee
[/wpsm_price_column] [wpsm_price_column size="2" featured="no" name="Lifetime Access" price="$249" per="Lifetime" button_color="orange" button_url="https://www.elegantthemes.com/join/" button_text="Buy Now"]
  • Access To Divi, Extra, Bloom & Monarch
  • Hundreds Of Website Packs
  • Lifetime Updates
  • Lifetime Premium Support
  • Unlimited Website Usage
  • Risk-Free Guarantee
  • One Time Fee
[/wpsm_price_column] [/wpsm_price_table]     For that rate, you get access not only to Divi but also to every one of the other themes and plugins of Elegant Themes.

Competitors Themes

[wpsm_box type="green" float="none" text_align="center"] WPastra Avada [/wpsm_box]

Final Verdict

I can see why people purchase Divi. It has a whole lot going for it particularly after the launch of Divi 4 which included style building functionality which was not available, now it's right here. I will state that the prices and the lifetime alternative are really attractive. The Divi team over the last 12 months has become a well-oiled machine cranking out amazing attributes as well as improvements. They likewise have actually pressed out a crazy amount of totally free templates as well as a template supervisor for them if that had not been enough. It's a good value around in spite of the concerns pointed out over. As mentioned, Divi is the flagship production of Sophisticated Styles. It's what's commonly referred to as a huge theme. Next, you can continue to modify the page with the Divi Builder.

node.title: Wordfence
node.content:
[wpsm_toplist]

Overview

Security is the most essential component that a site has to own to protect itself and its customers’ privacy. Without security, all of one’s hardwork will be in vain. So secure your WordPress website with Wordfence. It is the most downloaded security plugin that is powered by the constantly updated Threat Defence feed and thus their Web application stops your site from being hacked. Its powerful Wordfence scan provides a leverage for the same proprietary feed by alerting you really fast in the event of a potential hack or threat. It provides a real-time visibility to the traffic on your site along with a deep set of additional tools that make this the most complete security solution to all our threats.  

Benefits

[wpsm_box type="gray" float="none" text_align="left"] [wpsm_list]
  • Scans for many backdoor threat creators like C99, R57, Rootshell, Crystal shell, Sniper, Predator, GFS, Cybershell, etc.
  • Scans for heart-beat vulnerability
  • Scans core files, themes, plugins in the repository versions to check for integrity.
  • Optionally secure and change files that were under security threat.
  • Scans the signature of over 44,000 known WordPress malware variants.
  • Scans for heuristic of backdoors, trojans, suspicious code, phishing URLs, even URLs on the Google safe browsing list.
  • Fully Ipv6 compatible and includes whois lookup, location, blocking and security functions.
[/wpsm_list] [/wpsm_box]

Pro's & Con's

[wpsm_divider top="20px" bottom="20px" style="dotted"] [wpsm_column size="one-half"][wpsm_pros title="PROS:"]
  • Sign in with password and phone - two factor authorization for high security authentication.
  • Web application firewall protects site from getting hacked from malicious traffic before they can attack.
  • Threat defence fields auto-updates firewall rules.
  • Blocks common WordPress threats like GoogleBots, malicious scans from hackers and bots.
  • Checks strength of password and enforces a strong one to improve login security.
  • Controls WordPress from revealing data and locks out brute force hacks.
[/wpsm_pros][/wpsm_column][wpsm_column size="one-half" position="last"][wpsm_cons title="CONS:"]
  • Updates causes plugin to forget API key
  • Bluehost together with Wordfence causes problems.
[/wpsm_cons][/wpsm_column] [wpsm_divider top="20px" bottom="20px" style="dotted"]

node.title: Anti-spam Pro
node.content:
[wpsm_toplist]

Overview

Anti-spam Pro plugin blocks spam in comments. Anti-spam Pro is powerful and extended version of free and popular Anti-spam plugin. Plugin distinguishes automatic and manually submitted comments and use different spam checks to block spam. Anti-spam Pro plugin use few spam-bots characteristics to distinguish comments from automatic spam.

  • Anti-spam Pro plugin blocks 100% of automatic spam messages (sent by spam-bots via post requests) and about 50% of manual spam
  • Anti-spam Pro plugin works with JavaScript disabled.
  • Ability to hide or show info block in the “Screen Options” section
  • Ability to block manual spam using “spam-points algorithm”
[/wpsm_list] [/wpsm_box]

  • spam-bots are fully automatic and fills all the inputs using typical parsing patterns which can be easily trapped
  • Plugin distinguishes automatic and manually submitted comments and use different spam checks to block spam.
  • The Anti-spam Pro input names have random unique suffix what adds extra layer of protection.
  • Enqueue script only for pages with comments form and in the footer
  • Refactor code structure and added blocked spam counter in the comments sectio
[/wpsm_pros][/wpsm_column][wpsm_column size="one-half" position="last"][wpsm_cons title="CONS:"]

Extra hidden fields are added to comments form. First field should be filled with unique code. Second field should be empty. If the user visits site, than first field is answered automatically with JavaScript, second field left blank and both fields are hidden by JavaScript and CSS and invisible for the user. If the spammer will try to submit comment form, he will fail to fill code-input with correct code or will try to submit an empty field and spam comment will be automatically rejected. node.title: WP Fastest Cache
node.content:
[wpsm_toplist] [wpsm_divider top="20px" bottom="20px" style="solid"]  

Overview

WP Fastest Cache is one the simplest and fastest cache plugins. This plugin creates static HTML files from your dynamic WordPress blog. When a page is rendered, PHP and MySQL are used. Therefore, system needs RAM and CPU. If many visitors come to a site, system uses lots of RAM and CPU so page is rendered so slowly. In this case, you need a cache system not to render page again and again. Cache system generates a static HTML file and saves. Other users reach to static HTML page.

Benefits

[wpsm_box type="gray" float="none" text_align="left"] [wpsm_list]
  • Minify HTML allows you to decrease the size of the page
  • Minify CSS allows you to decrease the size of CSS files
  • Enable Gzip compression to reduce the size of files sent from server to increase speed of transfer to browser
  • Leverage browser caching to reduce page load times for repeated visitors.
  • Combine CSS to reduce number of HTTP round-trips by combining multiple CSS resources into one.
  • Combine JavaScript file into one.
  • You don’t need to modify .htaccess file since it gets automatically modified.
[/wpsm_list] [/wpsm_box]

Pricing

[wpsm_box type="solid_border" float="none" text_align="left"] Price:   Starting from $49.99/site Pricing model: Subscription [wpsm_price_table] [wpsm_price_column size="3" featured="no" name="Bronze" price="$49.99" ]

Pro's & Con's

  [wpsm_divider top="20px" bottom="20px" style="dotted"] [wpsm_column size="one-half"][wpsm_pros title="PROS:"]
  • Setup of this plugin is extremely easy.
  • All cache files are deleted when a post or page is published.
  • Admin can delete all cache files from the options page
  • Admin can delete minified CSS and JavaScript files from the options page
  • Blocked cache for specific posts or pages with short code.
  • Cache timeout options where all cached files are deleted at the determined time for specific pages.
  • Enable/disable cache options for logged-in users even on mobile devices
  • SSL and CDN support

[/wpsm_pros][/wpsm_column][wpsm_column size="one-half" position="last"][wpsm_cons title="CONS:"]

Summary/Conclusion

It is a great and really fast cache plugin to improve site performance and speed. According to its developers, the WP Fastest Cache plugin is “the simplest and fastest WP Cache system”. Similar to WP Super Cache, WP Fastest Cache generates static HTML files based on your dynamic WordPress blog and saves it in the cache. WP Fastest Cache prides itself on providing an easy-to-install plugin – and it delivers. You don’t even have to modify the .htaccess configuration file. The plugin uses mod_rewrite to create static HTML files on your website. node.title: WP Cerber
node.content:
[wpsm_toplist]

Overview

WP Cerber is a professional grade anti-spam plugin that protects users from brute force attacks by simply limiting the number of login attempts through the login form, XML-RPC requests and auth cookies. It also restricts access with Black IP Access list and White IP Access list. They also have a re-captcha to protect registration from spam registrations. It also tracks user, bot and hacker activity and hardens WordPress.

Benefits

[wpsm_box type="gray" float="none" text_align="left"] [wpsm_list]
  • Restricts access to XML-RPC, REST API and feeds with White Access list with IP or subnet
  • Stop user enumeration by blocking access to certain pages.
  • Block proactively IP subnet class C for an intruder’s IP.
  • It has an effective re-captcha to protect login/register/lost password forms
  • It has a citadel mode for massive brute force attacks
  • It also maintains an effective database and writes failed attempts down on sys logs or custom log files.
  • Inspect and filter out activities list by IP, username or particular eventand handle site or server behind revere proxy
  • Optional admin notifications and trigger and action for the JetFlow Automation plugin
[/wpsm_list] [/wpsm_box]

Pricing

[wpsm_box type="solid_border" float="none" text_align="left"] Price: $99/ year Pricing model: Subscription model [wpsm_price_table] [wpsm_price_column size="2" featured="no" name="Single" price="$99" per="year"]
  • 1 Website
  • Cerber Security Cloud Protection
  • Layered spam protection
  • Automated malware scans
  • Automated integrity checks
  • Rich GEO access rules
  • Professional support
  • 30-Day Money Back Guarantee
[/wpsm_price_column] [wpsm_price_column size="2" featured="no" name="5 Value Pack" price="$399" per="year"]
  • 5 Website
  • Cerber Security Cloud Protection
  • Layered spam protection
  • Automated malware scans
  • Automated integrity checks
  • Rich GEO access rules
  • Professional support
  • 30-Day Money Back Guarantee
  • Developer Support
[/wpsm_price_column] [/wpsm_price_table] Free Trial: Free version available. [wpsm_button color="orange" size="medium" link="https://wpcerber.com/#cerber-pricing" class="" target="_blank"]Pricing Details[/wpsm_button]  [/wpsm_box]

Pro's & Con's

[wpsm_divider top="20px" bottom="20px" style="dotted"] [wpsm_column size="one-half"][wpsm_pros title="PROS:"]
  • Limits login attempts while logging in by IP addresses or entire subnet.
  • It also monitors the logins made by login forms, XML-RPC requests or auth cookies
  • Lets you create a custom login URL
  • Hide options for wp-admin, wp-login, wp-signup, wp-register from possible attacks and return 404 HTTP error if the user hasn’t logged in
  • Immediately block IP or subnet if a user tries to login with wrong or non-existant username
  • Log all activities related to logging in/out process
  • Options to disable WP REST API, XML-RPC , feeds like RSS, Atom and RDF.
  • Disable automatic redirecting to login page
  • Options to hide WordPress dashboard
[/wpsm_pros][/wpsm_column][wpsm_column size="one-half" position="last"][wpsm_cons title="CONS:"]
  • Switches to citadel mode immediately after installation
  • If display of 404 error is opted, only HTML is reproduced without the CSS
[/wpsm_cons][/wpsm_column] [wpsm_divider top="20px" bottom="20px" style="dotted"]

Competitors Plugins

[wpsm_box type="green" float="none" text_align="center"] Anti-spam pro Akismet [/wpsm_box]

Summary/Conclusion

By default WordPress allows unlimited login attempts either through the login form or by sending special cookies. This allows passwords to be cracked with relative ease via brute force attack. WP Cerber blocks intruders by IP or subnet from making further attempts after a specified limit on retries is reached, making brute force attacks or distributed brute force attacks from botnet impossible. You will be able to create a Black Access List or White Access List to block or allow logins from particular IP. Moreover, you can create your custom login page and forget about automatic attacks to the default wp-login.php, which takes your attention and consumes a lot of server resources. If an attacker tries to access wp-login.php they will get a 404 Error response. [wpsm_toggle title="Main Features"]
  • Automatic detection of bots, robots and hackers
  • Citadel mode for massive brute force attacks
  • Configurable email notifications with rate limiting

node.title: Cloudflare
node.content:
[wpsm_toplist]

Overview

Cloudflare operates a highly-available global content delivery network that has actually security steps built into every layer and frequently clocks in lightning-fast speeds, and one of the biggest players in the Web security platform

According to Cloudflare, typically a site utilizing Cloudflare loads two times faster, uses 60% less bandwidth, has 65% fewer requests and is more secure.

At the time, the company reports of running over 200+ data centers worldwide.

Feature Set

Cloudflare discovers the geolocation of the visitors and directs them to its nearest data center. This serves your content from its own cache if possible, enhancing action times.

It can stop or limit abusive bots, limit comment spam, protect crucial ports (SSH, telnet, FTP) from hackers, or identify and reduce DDoS attacks in numerous ways.

Quality extras include some effective image optimizations. Cloudflare's 'Polish' innovation works to minimize image file sizes by an average of 35%, while 'Mirage' uses numerous strategies to optimize how images are shown on mobile phones. These functions alone might make a huge speed difference to some websites.

Setup

Signing up to Cloudflare works similar to any other web service. Enter your email address, pick a password, and you are ready to go

Setting Cloudflare for your domain includes pointing of domain name servers to Cloudflare. This requires visiting your domain registrar, web hosting or whoever else is handling your domain, and following the guidelines in their control panel.

It will probably take a couple of hours for the brand-new settings to spread around the web, however there's no downtime; your site will continue working as regular.

Pricing

The Cloudflare range starts with a basic free plan. This puts limitations on some features.
Following are the details pricing of the Cloudflare.

node.title: cPanel
node.content:
[wpsm_toplist]

Overview

cPanel is a user interface for customizing and making changes to your hosting account. cPanel is a Linux-based control panel that provides users with a control panel that allows them to manage a range of components on their website. Easy to learn and basic to use, cPanel is among the most popular control panel utilized to make sites run more efficiently.

User Interface

cPanel is highly identifiable across the hosting industry. So it's more than likely that you find it familiar. The user interface of cPanel, nevertheless isn't terrific given that it does not group the features and tools as helpfully, and is typically seen as being more messy compared to its rivals like Plesk. cPanel does allow for personalization of the home screen to make it a bit easier to find things, and the exposure of all functions in one location can make it much easier to find a function for the first time. [caption id="attachment_6453" align="alignnone" width="300"] Cpanel[/caption]  

Performance

cPanel is the web hosting control panel that has really focused on optimizing the performance. By focusing on reducing the quantity of memory needed. cPanel's developers were able to accelerate the page-load times within the panel, also achieve faster times for account creation and other server management jobs.

Features and Tools

Out of package, cPanel offers users with the primary features for server and account management. Both can be used to set up DNS settings, manage email accounts, run FTP (File Transfer Protocol) and manage databases. Although it is possible to add extra apps to cPanel, comes with support for better apps and extensions straight from package. cPanel is only offered on Linux running systems. The Linux distributions that support cPanel are CentOS, CloudLinux and RedHat Enterprise Linux operating systems.

Security

cPanel is greatly concentrated on security and comes with many security tools. You can also add helpful extensions as per your need. cPanel's security tools consist of: Automatic SSL certificate installation, password-protected directories and IP address denials.

Pricing

Their basic plan starts at $15/month for 1 user Suited for small businesses, freelancers or anyone needing just one hosting account. They have higher plans optimal for mid-level businesses and large agencies which allows for scalability.

Support

cPanel is highly identifiable throughout the hosting market. So it's more than likely that you find support from your community if you require it. In addition to community support, you likewise have the cPanel documentation, and dedicated Support Center with e-mail support or tickets.

Final Words

Your choice could be based on your operating system, but it will probably come down to which web panel you find much easier to use. While the functions in cPanel are fairly comparable to any other panel you'll probably choose the feel and experience of using one over the other.

node.title: BunnyCDN
node.content:
[wpsm_toplist]

Overview

A content delivery network (CDN) is a solution you can incorporate with your website to provide data, usually CSS, JS as well as picture documents, from data center locations closest to where your users live for enhanced speed as well as uptime performance. Founded in 2015, BunnyCDN is a fast yet economical CDN service based out of Slovenia. It's configured over 50,000 pull zones and also delivers over 40,000 TB well worth of data on a monthly basis. It gives a number of various CDN remedies, including around the world information facility areas, video delivery, software application distribution and also cloud storage space. It likewise has 6 data centers in Oceania, making it a powerful solution for companies offering clients in Australia as well as New Zealand.

Feature Set

Obtain a cost-free SSL certification with a click of a switch making use of BunnyCDN easy Let's Encrypt integration. BunnyCDN is fully HTTP/2 and Brotli prepared, supplying the efficiency as well as protection of the future. On the fly image optimization and processing permits you to control pictures with an easy query string. Get full understanding right into your web traffic utilizing BunnyCDN next generation real-time tracking dashboard. Define customized guidelines to control delivery, protection, directing, verification and more directly on the edge, and also secure your web content as well as save money by blocking or rerouting IPs or countries to less costly areas.

Setup

Setting up BunnyCDN in WordPress is pretty simple. Create an account in BunnyCDN and create a brand-new Pull Zone. A 'Pull Area' tells BunnyCDN where to pull the content/files (i.e. your site). You will get a hostname in this step. If you’re using a cache plugin like WP Rocket, then goto its CDN settings and enter the above hostname. Only these default setup is enough to operate BunnyCDN in you site, But there is some more settings you can do to get more results. Like activating Force SSL (Redirects All http to https). Setting how long the file will be cached in browser, Enabling Dynamic WebP support (Images delivers to the browser with or washout WebP support) and Enabling Bunny optimizer ( Resize or compress the image based on the requirement).

Pricing

The BunnyCDN gives you the 14 days of free trail after that there is different range based on your requirements. Lightning fast performance with region based pricing and access to BunnyCDN full network. [wpsm_price_table] [wpsm_price_column size="2" featured="no" name="Standard" price="43Pops" per="month" button_color="blue" button_url="https://bunnycdn.com/pricing" button_text="View"]

  • Asia & Oceania $0.03/GB
  • South America $0.045/GB
  • Middle East & Africa $0.06/GB
[/wpsm_price_column] [wpsm_price_column size="2" featured="no" name="Volume" price="8PoPs" per="month" button_color="blue" button_url="https://bunnycdn.com/pricing" button_text="View"]
  • First 500TB $0.005/GB
  • From 500TB-1PB $0.004/GB
  • From 1PB-2PB  $0.003/GB
  • From 2PB+ $0.0025/GB
[/wpsm_price_column] [/wpsm_price_table] PoPs: (Points of Presence) are strategically located data centers responsible for communicating with users in their geographic vicinity. Mnimum Monthly Cost: $10 per Year [wpsm_button color="orange" size="medium" link="https://bunnycdn.com/pricing" icon="none" class="" target="_blank"]Estimate Monthly Biill[/wpsm_button]

Pro's & Con's

[wpsm_column size="one-half"][wpsm_pros title="PROS:"]
  • BunnyCDN’s UI is fast, easy to navigate and well designed.
  • A free SSL certificate is available from Let’s Encrypt.
  • Along with SSL certificates and global data centers, BunnyCDN allows you to block users and IP addresses by country, blacklist IP addresses and more
  • Monitor how much bandwidth you’ve served and cached as well as how much traffic.
  • There is a smooth video playback.
  • You can add your own subdomain as a hostname to change the URL’s for files passed through BunnyCDN’s network.
  • A simple query API that allows you to deliver images faster and with lower bandwidth.
  • Upload to central storage
[/wpsm_pros][/wpsm_column][wpsm_column size="one-half" position="last"][wpsm_cons title="CONS:"]
  • There is no option for Dynamic content delivery.
  • BunnyCDN won't support Anti-DDoS.
  • Sometimes may give broken things in free trial.
[/wpsm_cons][/wpsm_column]

Final Words

On the whole, BunnyCDN is an effective and effective CDN solution that's unbelievably very easy to establish as well as also less complex to handle. It's expanded quite a bit because it was founded, all right to compete with one of the most widely known names in the sector. The business's cloud storage space and also Bunny Optimizer services actually make it stand out from the remainder. While other firms offer their very own variations of these services, they do not use easy cloud storage space options or as many optimization functions as BunnyCDN.

node.title: SiteGround
node.content:
Overview

SiteGround is a website hosting provider crafted for easy website management, There are powerful in-house features in Siteground that makes your website faster and safe. SiteGround servicing more than 2,000,000 domains worldwide. Siteground  provides shared hosting, cloud hosting and enterprise solutions as well as email hosting and domain registration services

Uptime Throughout the Year

Uptime is one of the most critical elements when picking a web host. After all, if your website is down, your users can't access it. So, constant uptime ought to be among your top priorities when taking a look at hosting services. SiteGround quickly exceeds these criteria, conveniently keeping our test site live for 99.99% of the time throughout the last 12 months.(One minute down in 12 months)

Speed and Performance

A slow site often means less traffic and, for that reason, lower sales numbers. So right after uptime, page loading time is the 2nd most important thing that can make or break your website's success. Our test site with SiteGround has provided an average load  loading time of 673ms isn’t the fastest we’ve seen, but it does place SiteGround near the top 10 at speed.

Included Packages

SiteGround provides different plans and packages which includes, Free site Migration for 1 website, Free SSL Certificate setup and Free Content Delivery Network (CDN). SiteGround has Collaboration tools that allow you to easily manage your clients, collaborate on sites, and transfer ownership of newly built sites to clients. SiteGround uses AI bot prevention tool to give more security to the websites. You’ll get Git pre-installed on bigger plans,  They have multiple PHP versions at your disposal. Multi-level caching is available. And you can also get access to staging environments for sites to prep or test before pushing new features into production.

node.title: Bluehost
node.content:
Overview

Bluehost is house to more than 2 million sites. Being top-notch in hosting services, and an official WordPress recommended hosting provider, they're able to offer high discount rates. Bluehost provides a wide variety of hosting plans for newbies to larger businesses with a 24/7 consumer support. See the complete Bluehost review by our specialists to find out if Bluehost is the ideal option for you.

Uptime Throughout the Year

Uptime is one of the most critical elements when picking a web host. After all, if your website is down, your users can't access it. So, constant uptime ought to be among your top priorities when taking a look at hosting services. Fortunately, Bluehost quickly exceeds these criteria, conveniently keeping our test site live for 99.98% of the time throughout the last 12 months.

Speed and Performance

A slow site often means less traffic and, for that reason, lower sales numbers. So right after uptime, page loading time is the 2nd most important thing that can make or break your website's success. Our test site with Bluehost has provided an average load speed of 641 ms over the past year. While it isn't competing for the top positions, it isn't bad either.

Included Packages

With the most affordable plans, Bluehost supplies your site with a free SSL certificate. You also get access to great functions like a complimentary CDN (Cloudflare), a one-click WordPress set up, multiple CMS combinations, and extra e-commerce plugins. Higher-tier plans come with the Spam Experts add-on, domain personal privacy, and server backups. Also, you get advanced security features such as SiteLock, which assists to avoid malware attacks. Dashboard and Usability

Bluehost is terrific for novices, too. The layout of the cPanel control panel makes Bluehost even easier to use. Newbies can easily install and start WordPress through cPanel. All you require doing is point and click most of the time. [caption id="attachment_6400" align="aligncenter" width="722"] Bluehost Home[/caption]

Money-Back Guarantee

Bluehost offers a 30-day money-back assurance with all of their hosting plans. You can check out the service to see their efficiency on your own and request for a refund if you're not completely pleased. They have a few words of caution, though. It's not specifically a no-questions-asked policy like we have actually seen from some hosts. So ensure you agree with these points before registering.

Support and Customer Care

It is truly crucial that you select a web hosting company that provides help and support when you need it. Bluehost keeps a substantial library of posts, step-by-step guides, and video tutorials as part of their substantial knowledge base. This is a substantial support for newbies and most typical problems can be rapidly resolved by an easy search. Bluehost provides a 24/7 support group where you can talk with their consumer assistance agents using live chat or phone. This is truly valuable when you require fast help from technical support staff. [wpsm_column size="one-half"][wpsm_pros title="PROS:"]
  • Over 2,000,000 websites worldwide are hosted by Bluehost so the company is obviously doing something right
  • Provides a wide range of web-hosting choices

Bluehost is typically ranked #1 hosting company by numerous sites. They provide a wide variety of hosting plans with lots of features that help you easily construct your website. All their hosting strategies include expert 24/7 client assistance from experienced personnel. Most notably, they use economical starter plans that fit any spending plan requirement.

node.title: Mailchimp
node.content:
[wpsm_toplist]

Mailchimp is typically the very first newsletter tool that comes to mind, perhaps due to the fact that they have excellent marketing and a lovely visual interface.

When it comes to your consumer relationships, they offer AI-powered, user-friendly tools anybody can use to become more successful.

Features

Email Automation

Effective, alongside to send follow-up emails based upon particular conditions, for instance, clicks, opens and so on. More complex automations in regard to goals/page link actions are offered, nevertheless, the functionality isn't fantastic as there is no workflow view.

List Management

Mailchimp provides pretty good segmentation methods, permitting you to integrate as much as 5 negative or favorable conditional relationships (e.g. what e-mail customer they use, whether they have actually opened a specific project).

Opt-in Forms

Basic drag & drop setup for forms, although a bit picky to choose color options, just permitting you to add the color code. You can add your own fields, and including the kind to your site is simple. They likewise offer pop-up registration forms to integrate with your site.

Deliverability

Mailchimp deliverability is acceptable, their general deliverability is around 84%. Nevertheless, be aware that their emails typically end up in the Gmail 'Promos' tab, which is less regularly examined.

Reports and Analysis

Practically all you require in regard to reporting is here, if not a little dull-looking. You have openers, Google Analytics combination (which permits conversion tracking), as well as clients, geo-tracking and social networks.

Integrations

There are over 800 integrations available for mailchimp! From e-commerce, to social and site combinations, you'd be difficult pushed to find an area that's not represented. Remarkably, they no longer offer a direct combination with Shopify, although there are third party integrators like Zapier that can be used to connect the two.

Authentication

DKIM and SPF, SenderID and DomainKeys readily available.

Various levels of account

You have 5 various levels within Mailchimp: viewer, author, supervisor, owner & admin. This is only available in higher plans.

Pricing

There is a free tier available with limited features. Mailchimp plans begins at $9.99 per month.
Mailchimp has recently altered its pricing framework as part of its move toward a full-service system. A small business with 2,000 contacts can select the cost-free version, which also uses simple templates and also an advertising and marketing CRM.

Support

Free plans do not include support. Nevertheless, the easily available documentation is excellent. Furthermore, free plans actually come with 30 days of free email support to get you started.

Paid plans have 24/7 email support. When you need assistance, they react reasonably promptly. Chat support is available during the day from Monday to Friday.

Video

node.title: SendGrid
node.content:
[wpsm_toplist] SendGrid is a cloud-based SMTP carrier that enables you to send e-mail without having to preserve email web servers. SendGrid handles all of the technical details, from scaling the facilities to ISP outreach and also online reputation tracking to whitelist solutions and actual time analytics.

Features

Design and templates

With SendGrid, you can utilize their email layout home builder to produce a highly customizable layout with WYSIWYG (What You See Is What You Obtain) project creation. You also have accessibility to HTML when you require it using SendGrid's code editor that's one of the very best on the marketplace. A huge advantage of SendGrid is the choose-your-path modifying choices, whether you choose visual layout, code, or a mix of both.

Signup forms

Their basic forms are a new addition to their product, and also you can embed them on a SendGrid organized web page or on your web site as well as likewise hook them as much as your automated workflows.

List Management

With SendGrid you can easily include calls and customized area data using CSV, signup kinds, or API integrations. SendGrid arranges calls by checklists and sections, which you can establish manually or make vibrant based upon determined standards.

Automation

SendGrid's automation functionality was till lately in beta, yet it's now a fully fledged part of their item. It enables you to deliver welcome e-mails with an onboarding series, support participants ahead of an occasion, as well as follow up with leads who communicate with web content. You can send automated mails when
  • The first time a contact is added to a list, or
  • The first time a contact is added to a segment.

Deliverability

SendGrid shares that customers who use their Expert Services have a 97% average delivery rate, compared to the 85% industry average.

Reports and Analysis

After sending an e-mail with SendGrid, you can easily access private campaign data (such as opens up, clicks, unsubscribes, or which emails mosted likely to spam) plus geography, device and ISP statistics. You can likewise utilize their A/B testing tool, or separate different email kinds right into customized groups to make your performance evaluation a lot more informative. A nifty feature in SendGrid is their Reputation Monitoring indicator.

Customer support

 

Various levels of account

You have 4 various levels within SendGrid: Free, Essentials, Pro, Premier

Pricing

On SendGrid's pricing page, you can choose whether you want their Email API, Marketing Campaigns, or Email API + Marketing Campaigns products. Like Mailchimp, SendGrid pricing also depends on your contacts and sending volume. With the Email API Plans, you can integrate email into your app or website. You can start with the Free plan with 40,000 emails for your first 30 days, then 100/day forever after that. Most teams sending transactional emails will need at least the SendGrid Essentials 40K plan long-term due to this limit.

Support

SendGrid provides 24/7 ticket support for all clients, 24/7 conversation assistance for paying consumers, as well as phone support is offered for customers with a Pro or higher account between 7:00 AM - 5:00 PM MST, Monday - Friday.

node.title: Generatepress
node.content:
[wpsm_reviewbox regular=1] [wpsm_toplist]

Choosing a theme is crucial to success when it comes to WordPress development. While creating a blog, what matters one of the most is just how content is interactive or extra reader-friendly?

There are a lot of WordPress themes, suggested by people for various functions for various kinds of websites however you will get stunned to know that a lot of blog owners use GeneratePress for their blogging sites.

GeneratePress is a fast loading multi-purpose WordPress theme. GeneratePress is preferred, not just for its clean styled, rapid loading, and its features, however a lot more for its flexibility with page builders and thrird party addons.

Why is GeneratePress so unique?

GeneratePress, nevertheless, isn't built for a specific particular niche. Instead, it works as a structure for different website themes-- from personal blogs to e-commerce shops.

GeneratePress can practically do anything to a wordpress site. And because GeneratePress has an emphasis on efficiency, the site that you build will be fast as a base.

Due to that, people who build WordPress websites with GeneratePress. They'll typically couple it with a WordPress page builder and utilize it for literally any type of type of site.

[wpsm_box type="solid_border" float="none" textalign="left"] [wpsm_list type="bullet" hover="1" gap="small"]

5 GeneratePress Features That Make It Unique, what GeneratePress Is Good For ...

  • Maximized Performance And Fast Page Load Times
  • Whole Lots Of Customization Options In The Real-Time WordPress Customizer
  • Page-Level Settings Give You Detailed Control Over Each Piece Of Content
  • Pre-Made Starter Sites Make It Easier To Design Your Site
  • Other Helpful Premium Extensions, Plus A Modular Approach
[/wpsm_list] [/wpsm_box]

Enhanced Performance and Page speed

GeneratePress has no code dependencies, swapping jQuery with vanilla JavaScript, the them has no render blocking resources that Google Page speed Insights usually mentions.

[wpsm_box type="solid_border" float="none" textalign="left"] Generatepress with default WordPress set up, will have a max page size of just 30 KB. In comparison, one of the most popular Astra Theme has a default page size of 50 KB.[/wpsm_box]

GeneratePress will supercharge your web site not only in speed but in every means. It offers you a totally free hand to design and personalize web pages.

Premium Modules

GeneratePress Premium opens additional components,  you can make use of to personalize how your WordPress website looks as well as functions. All the premium attributes of Generatepress are loaded right into a plugin as individual modules. Some notable modules are listed here

Website Library

GeneratePress premium features Site library for various niche. This enables to import the predesigned styles directly from their cloud websites with suitable plugins. It's simply like click and also go.

As I stated, the theme is created to support mostly all kinds of niches so below is the collection of built-in site Library which you can make use of with couple of clicks.

Elements

Elements are a terrific premium component of GeneratePress. It helps you to insert custom code as well as layout elements to any type of component of your Blog.

Elements function as a 3 parts header, hook, and layout. You can quickly utilize the components to customize your blog header, design, as well as hooks to place personalized codes as well as layout in your theme.

Woocommerce

Woocommerce is a totally free eCommerce plugin for WordPress to produce an eCommerce site.

GeneratPress Woocommerce module helps you to customize your product pages, cart and checkout pages, etc. making use of color combinations, design, typography alternatives in your website.

Other Helpful Premium Extensions

Beyond providing you a lot more style controls in the WordPress Customizer, GeneratePress Premium also features a great deal of other valuable features like:

[wpsm_list type="arrow" hover="1" gap="small"]
  • Header Module
  • Site Footer
  • Copyright Module
  • Import/ Export
  • Secondary Nav
You may check all the available premium modules from their Official website. [/wpsm_list]

Pricing

Generatepress has 2 premium plans: Yearly and Lifetime. Checkout full details of features and plans here.

Similar Themes

[wpsm_top postid="8314,1522,8302"]

Final Verdict

This theme incorporates a tidy, organized grid system with a highly-responsive user interface. It's also highly personalized, as well as thanks to the wide range of demo designs as well as pre-made formats for write-ups as well as pages, you don't require to have coding skills to create something unique.

node.title: Kadence

[wpsm_reviewbox regular=1] Kadence is simple, effective, and lightweight WordPress theme is rather hard. Among the new developers on the block now, Kadence is the most popular and trending WordPress theme. It boasts top-quality functions that make it rather very easy for you to design a style website. Seems like Kadence is giving a tough competition to top themes in the market like GeneratePress, Astra, and OceanWP. Kadence is a modern theme offered in two variations - A free version as well as a premium version. By recent official updates, KadenceWP is joining to iThemes, in the list of the very first commercial WordPress theme companies iThemes also come, they are the makers of plugins like iThemes Security Pro and BackupBuddy. Kadence Theme even in its free version, opens up to a whole lot of customization options that the existing themes fail to provide. That's the reason why the theme is creating a lot of buzz among Bloggers and WordPress users. [wpsm_column size="one-half"] [wpsm_list type="check" gap="small"]

  • Good Third-party Integrations
[/wpsm_pros][/wpsm_column][wpsm_column size="one-half" position="last"][wpsm_cons title="CONS:"]
  • Starter Templates are Limited
  • Limited page builder support

Pricing

Free version of Kadence is available with most of the essential features required for a standard WordPress site. However, attributes like the header add-ons, Theme hooks, and also the WooCommerce add-on is available only in the pro version. Kadence Theme Pro costs $59/year. If you plan to use the theme more than two years, lifetime variation of $129 is the better deal. You can get the Kadence Membership for $139/year packed with all their themes, plugins and future products. Kadence also provides a Lifetime subscription for $389. All plans come with a 30-day complete satisfaction warranty, which is excellent.

Similar Themes

[wpsm_top postid="1522,8314,716"]

Is Kadence Really worth the Hype?

When it concerns the theme options, the level of customization, the convenience of usage, and speed, Kadence just outperforms most of the popular themes in the market. The pre-built starter Templates and blocks are well made and look very professional. The support and the depth in the documentation of their themes and plugins are on par with 2020 standards. Kadence is perfect for you if you're looking for a pocket-friendly theme that gives you superior comfort with.

node.title: SEOPress
node.content:
[wpsm_reviewbox title="SEOPress : SEO Plugin" description="SEOPress is available in Free as well as premium version both versions have power-packed features that any website required to come up in the search results." criterias="Features:9.5;Performance:9;Support:10;Ease of use:10;Pricing:9.5;;" score="9.6" ] [wpsm_toplist] SEOPress is a WordPress plugin designed to produce search engine related settings. Much like Yoast and SEMrush, the plugin tries to gather all the essential parts of Search Engine Optimization and also arrange them right into a series of menus inside one plugin. SEOPress helps to present your site on search engines by doing on-page and on-site SEO in few clicks. SEOPress is available in Free as well as premium version both versions have power-packed features that any website required to come up in the search results.

SEOPress Freemium Features

1. Manage Titles & Metas

Title and meta is nothing but how the page, post or product should appear in the google search results we can give dynamic variable to set the titles and meta for all pages or posts or products or you can use individual titles and meta for each page, post or products. You can add target keywords to boost your search results.

2. XML/ Image/ Video/ HTML Sitemap

In simple terms, an XML sitemap is a list of your website’s URLs. It acts as a roadmap to tell search engines what content is available and how to reach it. XML sitemap is for a bot that helps to crawler your site better. HTML sitemap is just link so humans and bots can understand it.

3. Knowledge Graph

Knowledge Graph is talked about all your branding details or any particular person details like a website link, Socials media links, address, and other information You can add Facebook open graf and Twitter cards also here.

4. Google Analytics

Google Analytics is made use of to track website tasks such as session duration, pages per session, bounce price, and so on of people using the website, together with the information on the source of the traffic. It can be integrated with Google Ads Google Analytics technique is to reveal high-level, dashboard-type data for the informal user, as well as much more comprehensive information additionally right into the report set.

SEOPress Pro Features

1. Redirections

The most common Redirection method is 301 redirect which helps to avoid the page which you are not using but keeps that links. You can monitor 404 links also, SEOPress create 301 redirections in seconds to monitor the 404 and sends you the SMS alert. You can redirect every 404 to a custom URL also.

2. Broken link checker (BOT)

Using SEO Press pro you can scan broken links that are there not on your website. The bot scans links in your content to find errors (404). You can scan every post, page product, or custom type on the website. It will give a full report with broken links with error status and location where it was found, So it's to monitor and you can export this report also.

Google Structured Data types (Schemas)

Schemas are basically told to the search engine what should be the data mean. Schema markup is semantic vocabulary that you need to place on the website to help search engines to retrieve more results to the user. SEOPrress gives the option to add manually or automatic schemas to the page, post, product, or any other custom types. They are basically 12 data types given in the SEOPress you can use anyone based on your requirements. [wpsm_titlebox title="Different Schema Data Types" style="1"]
  • Local Business
  • Service
  • Article
  • Event
  • Job
  • Product
  • FAQ
  • Review
  • Recipe
  • Video
  • Course
  • Software Application
  • Custom
[/wpsm_titlebox] If you have confused that which schemas to use then you can follow the SEOPress Documentation.

SEOPress Free V/S Pro

SEOPress Pro gives some Add-on features to SEOPress free. To achieve a Broken link checker, Redirection, Schemas, and many others you need to use the Pro version. SEOPress will cost $39 / Year for Unlimited sites You can check full pricing later in this review. [wpsm_column size="one-half"] [wpsm_list type="check"]

Free Features

  • Installation wizard
  • Titles & metas

  • HTML Sitemap

  • Open Graph
  • Twitter Card
  • Content Analysis
  • Google Analytics (GDPR ready)
  • Matomo Cloud (GDPR ready)
  • Google Tag Manager (GDPR ready)
[/wpsm_list][/wpsm_column] [wpsm_column size="one-half" position="last"] [wpsm_list type="star"]

Pro Features

Pro's and Con's

  • Beginners can easily start with SEOPRess

node.title: Elementor Pro
node.content:
[wpsm_reviewbox title="Elementor Pro: Page Builder Plugin" description="Elementor Pro is a Drag and Drop page builder plugin with live preview and with more widgets. " criterias="Features:9;Performance:9;Support:9;Ease of use:10;Pricing:9.5;;" score="9.3" ] [wpsm_toplist] Elementor Pro is an add-on to the free version of Elementor page builder. It will give extra features to design advanced custom layouts and templates for the web pages. With the help of Dynamic content, you will be able to create a custom layout for Woocommerce related pages and products. Basic free version plugin is suitable to create attractive static pages, but to customize Header, Footer, Woocommerce pages Elementor pro is required. Elementor Pro works with any kind of theme you are using.

Elementor Pro Add-on Features

1. User Interface

With a modern user interface and live preview you can achieve the layout of a website based on your vision, even you do not even know to code. With the help of multiple sections and columns, you can create the most complex layout. Elementor Pro gives premium templates across multiple niches so you can import templates directly and customize that based on the requirements. Adding Custom CSS options give more flexibility over the design.

2. Elementor Pro widgets

Elementor Pro gives you 50+ elements in addition to free widgets, This will make your task easier, and no need to install any third-party plugins. You will get a Form widget that even sends the notification to your mail and integrates with Zapier so no need to use any form plugins likes, Ninja Forms, Fluent forms, or Gravity forms. Sliders Widget gives the best view for your landing page with a call to action button. You can showcase your previous works or any picture with the help of an advanced Gallery widget. The Social Share button gives the option to share any post or product on Social Media like Facebook or Twitter.

3. Pop Up Builder

Elementor Pop Up Builder is a powerful feature of the Elementor where you can create any sort of popup without using different popup makers. You can kind of Popups like Registration Form, Social Sharing, Woocommervce products and even place that pop-ups where you want in the page for example in the center, notification bar, sidebar or anywhere. With the flexible targeting, option content will pop up on the screen after some trigger happened. [wpsm_titlebox title="Triggering Options" style="1"]
  • Page Load
  • Exit intent
  • Clicks
  • Scroll depth (either a percentage or to a specific element)
  • After Inactivity
[/wpsm_titlebox] In advance options based on roles, based on device, some amount of page view you can trigger the popups. [wpsm_video]https://youtu.be/GGG6VftLiwU[/wpsm_video]

Elementor Theme Builder

Elementor Theme builder helps to create the entire theme setup or to create selected page templates. You can create a custom header, footer, blog page, Woocommerce shop page, or Woocommerce product page. The best use of theme builder is if you create a template for one post you can use that for every post, no need to create the same layout again. Theme builder gives some extra widgets to create post/product page templates some of them are Title, Author, Content, Excerpt, etc. You can add a template for the entire site or in a selected part of the site.

Dynamic Content

Dynamic content works with the concept of 'build it once and use that anywhere'. Dynamic content is Elementor's most powerful tool that is very useful in creating Dynamic templates, Dynamic content helps you to get content from anywhere from your site, and using that in your template is also easy. Creating a Dynamic template is an easy first drag and drop text widget then click the icon (showed below), the dropdown of dynamic tags will open you can select which one you want, the custom fields also appear in the list you can use that too.  

Elementor Free V/S Pro

With Elementor you can create an attractive website with more blocks and sections but to enhance that to the next levels you might require Elementor pro. The developers who want to make an experiment in the layout can use custom CSS options that give more flexibility to build layouts From a Marketing perspective, Popup builder gives more visitors to the site that will increase the leads.[wpsm_column size="one-half"] [wpsm_list type="check"]

node.title: LearnDash
node.content:
[wpsm_reviewbox title="LearnDash: Best LMS plugin for WordPress" description="Learndash is a online course builder plugin for WordPress, You can create courses and sell them online" criterias="Features:10;Performance:9;Support:9.5;Ease of use:8.5;Pricing:9.5;" score="9.3" ] [wpsm_toplist] LearnDash is a well-known plugin to create and sell any kind of online courses, User can create their own learning management system (LMS) using this plugin. LearnDash has some great features, With simple settings, you can create online courses quickly. If you are a master in any topic you can create a course based on that, sell them on your website and earn extra money through that. Different universities and some individual instructors are using LearnDash to teach online.

Creating LearnDash Courses

You can create any number of courses on a single website, adding quizzes, assignments, lessons, sections, and much more to a course. The course builder helps to structure the course with different sections by adding lessons and quizzes, Course builder has a drag and drop feature so you can drag any lessens to a particular course. This feature makes users change the sequence of the content easily. Course settings also have plenty of options like who can access these courses, prerequisites, progress bar, number of lessons completed, and much more. Here is the procedure to add courses using LearnDash [wpsm_video]https://youtu.be/6Sqs1EVWPSI[/wpsm_video]

Setting Up Course Lessons, Topics, Quiz

Lessons are different parts of your course to get differentiate between one topic and other you can use them. Even you can add different topics to each lesson. To add lessons or topics you can use visual course builder or dedicated option by going  Learndash>Lessons>Topics [wpsm_video]https://youtu.be/EHgIQEuZIZs[/wpsm_video] You can choose which course is associated with this lesson, You can add video lessons also. For topics also you can add which lesson and course is associate with this. [wpsm_video]https://youtu.be/pUn1evhecSI[/wpsm_video] If you want to add any Quizzes or Assignments in the course you can do that, Learndash gives full control and various options to create a quiz. Learndash gives the option to save the settings template for the quiz so you can use that in the future. For any questions in the quiz, you select what type of the answer should be (like multiple choice, fill in blanks, long answers, etc.) You can activate the assignments for the courses so after finishing, the user can able to upload that in the assignment area. [wpsm_video]https://youtu.be/EQkI-iVqd_A[/wpsm_video] You can view the Demo of Learndash here.

Woocommerce Integration

LearnDash gives many third-party and official addons to enhance its features, By using Woocommerce addon you can create paid courses, which means you can sell your courses on a subscription or fixed price basis and give users access to it. Using this addon you can create a product type as a course and select which course you want to sell then add a payment gateway your job is done. In several clicks, you can achieve this. You can associate one or multiple courses to the same product and works with a Woocommerce subscription also. [wpsm_video]https://youtu.be/308JgZncqQM[/wpsm_video] You can also use other addons to send an email notification to the users, Adding badges to the courses, get a better course layout, and much more. Some of the third-party addons are Zapier, bbpress, Stripe, Mailchimp, Slack, and many others.

Other Learndash Functionalities

1. Drip-Fed Content And Prerequisites

Making courses available at a certain duration or at a particular time is called Drip-Fed Content. To make better user engagement you can activate this feature. You can make content availibility for some days after signup or you can set a particular date to display the content. You can add course prerequisites also for some of the courses to check wheater the user is well known to complete this course. You can add some of the previous courses as prerequisites then you can check the course taker have potential.    

2. Video Progression Feature

If you make use of video clips in your training courses, LearnDash's Video Progression function makes it actually simple to install either self-hosted or externally hosted video clips.
  • Instantly mark lessons/topics as complete after the customer finishes the video clip
  • Send out students straight to the next video once it completes
  • Hide the play bar (to stay clear of skipping), autoplay videos, as well as lots more.
 

3. Automation Triggers

If the recipient did some specific things you can activate the triggers to perform some actions.

4. Easy Text Translation for Local Language

If English isn't your website's native language, LearnDash makes it simple to translate and localize your training course web content without the demand for a different plugin.  

Pro's and Con's

[wpsm_column size="one-half"][wpsm_pros title="PROS:"]
  • The Visual Course Builder Is Super Helpful
  • Cheaper than other Saas apps
  • Drag and drop features make a more organized course structure
  • Video progression helpful for video courses
  • Built in the language translator
  • Trigress automate more actions
[/wpsm_pros][/wpsm_column][wpsm_column size="one-half" position="last"][wpsm_cons title="CONS:"]
  • For Membership and payment you want third party addons
  • For new users its struggele to use
[/wpsm_cons][/wpsm_column]

Pricing.

LearnDash is a Premium plugin there is no free version, LearnDash comes in three different packages Pro, Plus, and Basic.   In the Basic package you won't get the Propanel feature, Propanel is reporting addon for LearnDash. For all these packages LearnDash gives One support and updates with 30 Days money-back guarantee.

Competitors Plugins

[wpsm_box type="green" float="none" text_align="center"] iSpring Market

Thinkific

[/wpsm_box]

Final Verdict

LearnDash is among one of the most popular WordPress LMS plugins. Its deep capability makes it a wonderful option for creating genuinely custom training courses. The only downside is that casual customers might struggle to identify all of that deep capability. You can watch Case studies and then decide whether to use this plugin or not.

node.title: Shortpixel
node.content:
[wpsm_reviewbox title="Shortpixel: Compress and Optimize your Images " description="Increase your site SEO rank by optimizing all sort of images without dropping the original quality" criterias="Features:9;Performance:9.5;Support:9;Ease of use:9.5;Pricing:10;" score="9.4" ] [wpsm_toplist] If your website loads faster, it will help to get more traffic to your website and push in the SEO ranking, and visitors also don't need to spend time while loading itself. To reduce the loading time of your website image optimization is must require. This is the easiest way to get loading time down. Shortpixel will help you in this scenario, you can compress any kind of image in different formats. Whenever you upload an image to the media library, this plugin compresses that image. Further, you can compress bulk images at any time. With more privacy, you can compress past website images also without breaking any links so this is an easy and safe way to optimize the site.

Shortpixel Plugin Features

Shortpixel is a popular image compressor plugin that is available in the WordPress repository. you can use the free version to check the features and functionalities of the plugin With basic features of the WordPress plugins like WP Smush and Imagify, Shortpixel has some more features. You can make your website quick compression test on Shortpixel website, That show how the image compression will take place, and you can compare original and compressed image there itself. There is no file format restriction in Shortpixel you can use JPG, PNG, GIF, or even PDF format to optimize. there is an option to convert PNG to JPG to reduce even more space in the server. There are three ways of compression takes place in Shortpixel based on your settings.

1. Lossless compression

Based on the Lossless algorithm this compression method will work. If the speed of your website is acceptable and you want to reduce some amount of image size then this method is the best one. The quality of the image will remain the same after the compression and a small amount of the size will reduce in the image.

2. Glossy Compression

This method gives better image quality and more focused on the Google insights and reduces only a small amount of the size. Overall the loading time was not going to be changed but google insights were pushed up.

3. Lossy Compression

A larger reduction in the file size and the image quality also not so high compared to the other two methods. You can do bulk optimization of the images and comparing the original image with the compressed image is also possible in this plugin. Shortpixel gives the option to resize your images too. No need to resize your images before uploading them to the WordPress Media library. Based on where you are using the image, Shortpixel automatically resizes that image. Shortpixel works with the cloud-based server you need to connect that with API to your WordPress site, so all the optimization process is taking place in the cloud so your server will run smoothly while optimization is going.

How to Start with ShortPixel free version

Download the free version of Shortpixel in the WordPress Repository. Activate the plugin. This plugin will operate based on API so you need to Get the API key from them. Go to settings ->Shortpixel. Enter your Email ID on Box and enter Request an API key Button then Shortpixel will activate your account automatically, You will get a Mail also with an API key so you can add it manually also. Then You can make some settings based on your requirement in the general tab, You can select which type of compression type you want like Lossy, Glassy, or Lossless. Set the option for image backup and removing the background metadata of the image by checking to remove the EXIF tag of the image. You can set the maximum width and height to maintain resize of the image. In the advance tab, you can find an option for convert PNG to JPEG and you can set automatically exclude some images from the optimization.

Quick Compression test

For better understanding let's make a quick compression test for the image. I used the image with file size 284kb with 700px X 400px total width and height. After compression, the file size was reduced to 41kb without damaging the quality of the original image.

ShortPixel Free V/S Pro

ShortPixel is a free plugin you will get in the WordPress repository but one limit in the free version is you can not optimize more than 100 images per month, other than this limit free version has the same features compare to pro versions. [wpsm_column size="one-half"] [wpsm_list type="check"]

Free Features

  • 100 images/Month
  • Regular support
  • Easy to use
  • No file size limit
  • One API key for multiple sites
  • Lossless, Glossy and Lossy optimization
  • Automatic and Bulk optimization
  • WordPress Plugin
[/wpsm_list][/wpsm_column] [wpsm_column size="one-half" position="last"] [wpsm_list type="star"]

Pro Features

  • 5,000/12,000/55,000 images/Month
  • Priority support
  • Easy to use
  • No file size limit
  • One API key for multiple sites
  • Lossless, Glossy and Lossy optimization
  • Automatic and Bulk optimization
  • WordPress plugin
  • Php compression tools
  • Cancel anytime
[/wpsm_list] [/wpsm_column]

Pro's and Con's

[wpsm_column size="one-half"][wpsm_pros title="PROS:"]
  • With a 90% compression rate trustworthy compression plugin
  • All files are supported
  • 3 different compression types
  • Supports automatic and bulk optimization
  • One-click backup
[/wpsm_pros][/wpsm_column][wpsm_column size="one-half" position="last"][wpsm_cons title="CONS:"]
  • You can not use unused monthly credit in next month
[/wpsm_cons][/wpsm_column]

Pricing

Shortpixel is the pocket-friendly plugin you will get a pro version for 5$. All features are the same in the free and pro versions except the limit of images per month and support. Pro version comes in 3 ways Short, Large, and XXL. ShortPixel gives a one-time payment option also you need to buy some credits first for that there is no time limit you can use until credits got over.  

Similar Plugins

Final Verdict

The final thought was first to start using the free version of ShortPixel once you noticed the compression quality and reduced image size you can get a pro version based on the requirement.

WP Fluent Form Features

Fluent Forms has all the necessary features required to make any customizable forms from the simple contact form to checkout form, you can build a hassle-free form with the help of extensive documentation for all the features and you can find each features tutorial on their youtube channel. With 30+ input fields and a user-friendly user interface, any beginner can develop a form in minutes.   Pre-build templates have made a huge difference compared to other form plugins like Gravity form or Ninja form, you will get 25+ free templates in the free version, these templates cover all the necessary areas of the form used. and you will get 60+ highly creative and responsive form template in the Pro version. These templates are differentiated from categories so find your use of the form and select desired form template and customize it in no time. The input fields in the Fluent Form are categorized into four parts General Fields, Advanced Fields, Container, and Payment Fields. By just doing the drag and drop to the theme builder you can use these fields. Conditional logic works smoothly in Fluent Form you can add Conditional logic for any of the fields stated above.

Fluent Forms Multistep and Multiple integrations

If you are creating the form with so many fields so the user gets bored to enter all the data on a single page so by adding different steps in the form you can create the best impression in the user's mindset and the look and feel of the forms further get better. So to make this possible fluent form add Multi step feature, If you have some long form then you can give a step1, step 2 options. On submitting the fields in step 1 user needs to click on the next button to go next, and the progression bar also a[pear on the top of the form with that also user get to know how many steps are remaining, and currently at which step I'm in. Basically to make things easy and clear in larger form this is the best way. The freemium version of Fluent Forms gives a wide range in integrating marketing tools, It gives integration of Zapier, Slack, and Mailchimp in the free version itself on the other hand if you want to use this integration in Gravity form plugin you need to get the premium version. Webhooks are easily integrated into Fluent Forms, with the integration of Zapier you can connect to 200 more tools with the integration of Ninja Table, users can manage their data table and showcase their things easily.

Advanced post creation & eSignature(pro)

Advance Post creation is creating an automatic post when the form is submitted this reduces the creating post in the backend from the entries of the form. This works with respect to metadata and any file like images, videos, or pdf attached in the form that is also got added in the post. In job listing sites or guest blogs by customer entries, we can use these features. By setting form scheduling and restrictions you can maintain the visibility of the form to different sorts of users. eSignature is the pro addon in Fluent Forms if any sensitive data your collecting from the customers then this field will become helpful to get signed by them. once added this addon the widget appears in advanced fields then you can use this anywhere in the form.

WP Fluent Form Free v/s Pro features

Wp Fluent Form Free version has more than 25 fields that you can use in the form with 25 + free templates. The pro version gives you the addition of some more features for the free version pro features like Payment gateway, eSignature, and many more. [wpsm_column size="one-half"] [wpsm_list type="check"]
